Kuch naya karo.
"Abhi tumhare andar sab kuch hai jo chahiye."
Occasion pe nahi, preparation pe girte/udte.
Ghadi ko mat dekho; uski tarah karo—lagataar chalte raho.
"Jab mind enlighten ho jata, purani darkness wapas nahi."
Motivation aati-jaati, discipline tikti.
"Think karte ho can, ya think karte ho can't—tum right."
"Goals ke level tak nahi uthte."
Aashavaad woh vishwas hai jo safalta ki ore le jaata hai.
Destination overnight nahi badlega, but direction abhi badal sakte.
